# 05 — API Design

**Project:** SmartKisan
**Version:** 2.0
**Base URL:** `https://api.smartkisan.in/api/v1`
**Spec:** OpenAPI 3.1, auto-generated by FastAPI at `/docs`

---

## 1. Conventions

| Aspect | Rule |
|---|---|
| Format | JSON only; UTF-8 |
| Naming | `snake_case` fields, plural resource paths |
| Auth | `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` on everything except `/auth/*` and `/reference/*` |
| Language | `Accept-Language: hi` header selects response language for user-facing strings |
| Versioning | URL path `/api/v1`. Breaking changes → `/api/v2` |
| Timestamps | ISO-8601 UTC (`2026-08-04T12:00:46Z`) |
| Money | Integer paise? **No** — `numeric` rupees with 2 decimals, as a JSON number |
| Idempotency | `Idempotency-Key` header honoured on all POSTs that create resources |

### 1.1 Every response carries provenance

This is a design rule, not an option. Per P5 and FR-3.9, the client must always be able to show
the farmer where a number came from and how old it is.

```json
{
  "data": { },
  "meta": {
    "source": "AGMARKNET via data.gov.in",
    "data_as_of": "2026-08-04T12:00:46Z",
    "is_stale": false,
    "model_version": "price-forecast-v1.3.0",
    "request_id": "req_01J8XK2M9P"
  }
}
```

| `meta` field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `source` | Human-readable origin, shown in the UI |
| `data_as_of` | When the underlying data was produced (not when we served it) |
| `is_stale` | `true` when serving cache beyond its freshness window (P4) |
| `model_version` | Present whenever an ML model produced any part of `data` |
| `request_id` | Correlation ID; also in logs and Sentry |

### 1.2 Error envelope

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "PLOT_NOT_FOUND",
    "message": "Plot not found or not owned by you",
    "message_localized": "खेत नहीं मिला",
    "details": { "plot_id": "..." },
    "request_id": "req_01J8XK2M9P"
  }
}
```

| Status | Use |
|---|---|
| 400 | Validation failure (Pydantic details included) |
| 401 | Missing/expired token |
| 403 | Authenticated but not the owner of the resource |
| 404 | Not found |
| 409 | Conflict (duplicate, idempotency replay mismatch) |
| 422 | Semantically invalid (e.g. gap window shorter than every crop) |
| 429 | Rate limited — `Retry-After` header set |
| 503 | Upstream unavailable **and** no cache — rare by design |

## 2. Authentication

### `POST /auth/otp/request`
```json
// →
{ "phone": "+919876543210" }
// ←  200
{ "data": { "otp_sent": true, "expires_in": 300, "retry_after": 60 } }
```
Rate limit: 10/min/IP, 3/hour/phone. OTP is 6 digits, 5-minute TTL, stored hashed in Redis.

### `POST /auth/otp/verify`
```json
// →
{ "phone": "+919876543210", "otp": "482913" }
// ←  200
{
  "data": {
    "access_token": "eyJ…",  "refresh_token": "eyJ…",
    "token_type": "Bearer",  "expires_in": 900,
    "is_new_user": true
  }
}
```
`is_new_user: true` → client routes to onboarding.

### `POST /auth/refresh` · `POST /auth/logout`
Refresh rotates the refresh token (old one is revoked in Redis). Logout revokes both.

## 3. Profile — FR-1

### `GET /me` · `PATCH /me`
```json
{
  "data": {
    "id": "f_01J…",
    "name": "रमेश कुमार",
    "phone_masked": "+91987****210",
    "preferred_language": "hi",
    "gender": "male",
    "social_category": "OBC",
    "consent_given": true,
    "profile_completeness": 0.85
  }
}
```

### `POST /farms`
```json
// →
{
  "village": "Kachhwa", "district": "Karnal", "state": "Haryana",
  "latitude": null, "longitude": null       // omit → server geocodes via Nominatim
}
// ←  201
{
  "data": {
    "id": "fm_01J…", "village": "Kachhwa", "district": "Karnal", "state": "Haryana",
    "latitude": 29.7256, "longitude": 76.9107,
    "geocode_source": "nominatim", "geocode_confidence": "district_centroid"
  },
  "meta": { "source": "Nominatim / OpenStreetMap" }
}
```

> `geocode_confidence: "district_centroid"` tells the client to prompt the farmer to drop a
> precise pin — weather at the district centroid is not weather at their field.

### `POST /farms/{farm_id}/plots`
```json
// →
{
  "area_input_value": 5, "area_input_unit": "bigha",
  "soil_type": "alluvial",
  "irrigation_source": "tubewell",
  "previous_crop_code": "wheat",
  "previous_harvest_date": "2026-04-12"
}
// ←  201
{
  "data": {
    "id": "pl_01J…",
    "area_acres": 1.25,                       // 5 bigha × 0.25 (Haryana)
    "area_display": "5 बीघा (1.25 एकड़)",
    "conversion_note": "Haryana bigha = 0.25 acre",
    "soil_type": "alluvial", "irrigation_source": "tubewell"
  }
}
```

> **FR-1.5 in the contract:** the server always echoes the conversion so the farmer can catch a
> unit mistake before it corrupts every downstream rupee figure.

### `POST /plots/{plot_id}/soil-test` — optional SHC values (FR-1.6)

## 4. Gap Crop Recommendation — FR-2 *(flagship)*

### `POST /recommendations/gap-crop`

```json
// →
{
  "plot_id": "pl_01J…",
  "gap_start_date": "2026-04-15",
  "gap_end_date":   "2026-06-25",
  "preference": "balanced",          // "max_profit" | "min_risk" | "balanced"
  "include_excluded": true           // FR-2.8 transparency
}
```

```json
// ←  200
{
  "data": {
    "run_id": "rec_01J8XK…",
    "gap_days": 71,
    "usable_days": 64,                       // minus 7-day safety buffer
    "recommendations": [
      {
        "rank": 1,
        "crop": {
          "code": "summer_moong",
          "name": "समर मूंग",
          "name_en": "Summer Moong",
          "duration_days": { "min": 60, "max": 65 }
        },
        "score": 0.847,
        "economics": {
          "investment": 8125,
          "yield_qtl":  { "low": 6.9, "typical": 8.1, "high": 9.4 },
          "price_per_qtl": {
            "forecast": 8420, "lower_80": 8050, "upper_80": 8790,
            "as_of": "2026-08-04", "model_version": "price-forecast-v1.3.0"
          },
          "net_profit": { "low": 38400, "typical": 46900, "high": 54500 },
          "roi_percent": { "low": 472, "typical": 577, "high": 671 },
          "breakeven_yield_qtl": 0.96
        },
        "risk": {
          "score": 22, "band": "low",
          "factors": [
            { "factor": "price_volatility", "contribution": 0.08, "note": "स्थिर MSP समर्थन" },
            { "factor": "weather_risk",     "contribution": 0.11, "note": "जून की बारिश से फली सड़ सकती है" }
          ]
        },
        "benefits": {
          "nitrogen_fixation_kg_ha": 22,
          "next_crop_impact": "अगली धान की फसल में 15-20 किलो/हेक्टेयर यूरिया की बचत"
        },
        "explanation": {
          "summary": "मूंग सबसे अच्छा विकल्प है — 65 दिन में तैयार, आपकी मिट्टी और ट्यूबवेल के लिए उपयुक्त।",
          "reasons": [
            { "icon": "clock", "text": "65 दिन में तैयार — आपकी 71 दिन की अवधि में फिट" },
            { "icon": "soil",  "text": "जलोढ़ मिट्टी के लिए उपयुक्त" },
            { "icon": "leaf",  "text": "मिट्टी में नाइट्रोजन जोड़ेगी" }
          ],
          "warnings": [
            { "severity": "medium", "text": "जून में भारी बारिश से फली सड़ने का खतरा" }
          ]
        },
        "nearest_market": {
          "mandi_id": "md_01J…", "name": "Karnal Grain Market",
          "distance_km": 12.4, "latest_modal_price": 8550
        }
      }
    ],
    "excluded": [
      { "crop_code": "cotton",   "reason": "duration_exceeds_gap",
        "explanation": "कपास को 160 दिन चाहिए, आपके पास 71 दिन हैं" },
      { "crop_code": "cucumber", "reason": "soil_incompatible",
        "explanation": "खीरे को बलुई दोमट मिट्टी चाहिए" }
    ]
  },
  "meta": {
    "source": "SmartKisan recommendation engine",
    "model_version": "gapcrop-v2.1.0 · price-forecast-v1.3.0 · yield-v1.0.2",
    "data_as_of": "2026-08-04T12:00:46Z",
    "computed_in_ms": 340
  }
}
```

**Contract notes:**
- Every money field is a **range**, never a scalar (FR-2.6, P3)
- `excluded` is first-class output, not an afterthought (FR-2.8)
- `run_id` is persisted → the audit record required by FR-2.11
- Three model versions are named because three models contributed

### `POST /recommendations/{run_id}/feedback` — FR-2.12
```json
{ "crop_code": "summer_moong", "action": "planted", "sown_on": "2026-04-20" }
```
Later: `{ "actual_yield_qtl": 7.8, "actual_price_per_qtl": 8300, "actual_cost": 8400 }`
→ writes `cropping_history`, the feedback loop that trains v2.

### `GET /crops` · `GET /crops/{code}` — reference data, cacheable 24 h, works offline

## 5. Mandi Prices — FR-3

### `GET /mandi/prices`
`?commodity=Tomato&state=Haryana&district=Karnal&date=2026-08-04&limit=50`
```json
{
  "data": {
    "prices": [{
      "mandi": { "id": "md_01J…", "name": "Karnal Grain Market", "district": "Karnal", "distance_km": 12.4 },
      "commodity": "Tomato", "variety": "Other", "grade": "Medium",
      "arrival_date": "2026-08-04",
      "min_price": 4000, "max_price": 5000, "modal_price": 4500,
      "change_pct_1d": 2.3, "change_pct_7d": -5.1,
      "msp": null, "is_below_msp": false
    }]
  },
  "meta": { "source": "AGMARKNET via data.gov.in", "data_as_of": "2026-08-04T12:00:46Z", "is_stale": false }
}
```

### `GET /mandi/nearby` — FR-3.2, FR-3.7 *(the differentiating endpoint)*
`?commodity=Tomato&radius_km=60&quantity_qtl=20`
```json
{
  "data": {
    "options": [
      {
        "mandi": { "name": "Karnal Grain Market", "distance_km": 12.4 },
        "modal_price": 4500,
        "gross_revenue": 90000,
        "costs": { "transport": 1240, "mandi_fee": 900, "labour": 600 },
        "net_realisation": 87260,
        "net_per_qtl": 4363
      },
      {
        "mandi": { "name": "Azadpur Mandi, Delhi", "distance_km": 128 },
        "modal_price": 4900,
        "gross_revenue": 98000,
        "costs": { "transport": 12800, "mandi_fee": 980, "labour": 900 },
        "net_realisation": 83320,
        "net_per_qtl": 4166
      }
    ],
    "best_option": "Karnal Grain Market",
    "insight": "दिल्ली में भाव ₹400/क्विंटल ज़्यादा है, लेकिन ढुलाई के बाद ₹3,940 कम मिलेगा।"
  }
}
```

> This is FR-3.7 realised. AGMARKNET's own site shows the ₹4,900 and lets the farmer drive 128 km
> to lose money. **Sorting by `net_per_qtl`, not `modal_price`, is the product.**

### `GET /mandi/prices/history`
`?commodity=Tomato&mandi_id=md_…&period=90d` → daily series + `{min,max,avg,current_percentile}`

### `GET /mandi/forecast` — FR-3.5
```json
{
  "data": {
    "commodity": "Summer Moong", "mandi": "Latur APMC",
    "current_price": 8550,
    "forecasts": [
      { "horizon_days": 30, "target_date": "2026-09-03",
        "predicted": 8420, "lower_80": 8050, "upper_80": 8790, "direction": "flat" }
    ],
    "model_quality": {
      "mape_30d": 9.4, "baseline_mape_30d": 15.8,
      "beats_baseline": true, "interval_coverage": 0.81
    }
  },
  "meta": { "model_version": "price-forecast-v1.3.0" }
}
```

> **`model_quality` is returned to the client on purpose.** If `beats_baseline` is false, the UI
> hides the forecast entirely (NFR-6.3). The API tells the truth about itself.

### `POST /mandi/sell-advice` — FR-3.6
```json
// →  { "commodity":"Tomato", "quantity_qtl":20, "mandi_id":"md_…", "harvest_date":"2026-08-04" }
// ←
{
  "data": {
    "verdict": "SELL_NOW",
    "reason": "टमाटर जल्दी खराब होता है और भाव गिरने का अनुमान है",
    "today_net": 87260,
    "wait_30d_net": { "expected": 79400, "lower_80": 68200, "upper_80": 90600 },
    "spoilage_loss_estimate": 9800,
    "confidence": "medium"
  }
}
```

## 6. Disease Detection — FR-4

### `POST /disease/scan` — `multipart/form-data`, max 8 MB, JPEG/PNG
```json
// ←  200 — confident
{
  "data": {
    "scan_id": "sc_01J…",
    "status": "diagnosed",
    "disease": {
      "name": "टमाटर अगेती झुलसा", "name_en": "Early Blight",
      "pathogen": "Alternaria solani", "severity": "mild",
      "symptoms": "निचली पत्तियों पर गोल छल्लेदार भूरे धब्बे"
    },
    "confidence": 0.87, "confidence_is_calibrated": true,
    "gradcam_url": "https://…/sc_01J…_cam.jpg",
    "treatments": {
      "organic": [{
        "product": "ट्राइकोडर्मा विरिडी 1% WP", "dosage": "5 ग्राम/लीटर पानी",
        "phi_days": 0, "source_citation": "ICAR Package of Practices, Tomato, 2023, p.44"
      }],
      "chemical": [{
        "product": "मैंकोज़ेब 75% WP", "dosage": "2.5 ग्राम/लीटर पानी",
        "water_volume": "200 लीटर/एकड़", "phi_days": 7,
        "safety_warning": "छिड़काव के समय दस्ताने और मास्क पहनें। 7 दिन तक फल न तोड़ें।",
        "source_citation": "CIB&RC Label Claim, Mancozeb 75% WP, Tomato"
      }]
    },
    "spray_advisory": {
      "can_spray_today": false,
      "reason": "अगले 12 घंटे में 75% बारिश की संभावना — दवा बह जाएगी",
      "next_suitable_window": "2026-08-06 सुबह"
    },
    "disclaimer": "यह सलाह केवल मार्गदर्शन के लिए है। KVK से पुष्टि करें।"
  },
  "meta": { "model_version": "disease-effnetb0-v1.2.0", "inference_location": "on_device" }
}
```

```json
// ←  200 — OOD rejection (FR-4.4)
{ "data": { "status": "rejected_not_a_leaf",
            "message": "यह पत्ती की तस्वीर नहीं लगती। कृपया पत्ती की साफ़ फोटो लें।",
            "tips": ["पत्ती को सीधे कैमरे के सामने रखें", "अच्छी रोशनी में फोटो लें"] } }
```

```json
// ←  200 — uncertain (FR-4.5)
{ "data": { "status": "uncertain", "confidence": 0.52,
            "possibilities": [ { "name": "अगेती झुलसा", "confidence": 0.52 },
                               { "name": "सेप्टोरिया लीफ स्पॉट", "confidence": 0.31 } ],
            "message": "निश्चित पहचान नहीं हो पाई। कृपया KVK से संपर्क करें।",
            "kvk_contact": { "name": "KVK Karnal", "phone": "+91…", "distance_km": 18 } } }
```

> Three distinct 200 responses. **"Uncertain" and "rejected" are successful outcomes**, not errors —
> the API models P3 directly.

## 7. Government Schemes — FR-5

### `GET /schemes/eligible`
```json
{
  "data": {
    "eligible": [{
      "code": "PM_KISAN", "title": "पीएम-किसान सम्मान निधि",
      "benefit_amount_inr": 6000, "benefit_text": "₹6,000 प्रति वर्ष, 3 किस्तों में",
      "eligibility_reason": [
        { "rule": "land_holding_ha", "your_value": "1.42 हेक्टेयर", "required": "≤ 2 हेक्टेयर", "passed": true }
      ],
      "documents_required": ["आधार कार्ड", "खसरा/खतौनी", "बैंक खाता (NPCI लिंक)"],
      "applying_authority": "ग्राम पंचायत / CSC केंद्र",
      "official_url": "https://pmkisan.gov.in"
    }],
    "not_eligible": [{
      "code": "SMAM_TRACTOR", "title": "ट्रैक्टर सब्सिडी (SMAM)",
      "failed_rules": [
        { "rule": "min_land_ha", "your_value": "1.42 हेक्टेयर", "required": "≥ 2 हेक्टेयर", "passed": false }
      ],
      "near_miss": true,
      "explanation": "आपकी ज़मीन 0.58 हेक्टेयर कम है"
    }]
  },
  "meta": { "source": "SmartKisan rule engine (deterministic)", "evaluated_at": "2026-08-04T…" }
}
```

> `"source": "SmartKisan rule engine (deterministic)"` — no `model_version`, because **no model was
> involved** (FR-5.2). The absence of that field is the guarantee.

### `POST /schemes/{code}/ask` — RAG follow-up, citations required
```json
{ "data": { "answer": "आवेदन CSC केंद्र या pmkisan.gov.in पर…",
            "citations": [ { "text": "…", "source_url": "https://pmkisan.gov.in/Documents/Guidelines.pdf", "page": 4 } ] } }
```

## 9. Voice Assistant — FR-7

### `POST /assistant/chat` — SSE stream
```json
// →  { "conversation_id": "cv_…", "message": "गेहूं के बाद क्या लगाऊं?", "language": "hi" }
```
```
event: tool_call
data: {"tool":"get_gap_crop_recommendation","args":{"plot_id":"pl_…","gap_days":71}}

event: token
data: {"text":"आपके "}

event: done
data: {"message_id":"msg_…",
       "tool_calls":[{"tool":"get_gap_crop_recommendation","result_ref":"rec_01J8XK…"}],
       "numbers_used":[{"value":46900,"source":"tool:get_gap_crop_recommendation.net_profit.typical"}]}
```

> **`numbers_used` is the enforcement mechanism for FR-7.4.** Every numeric token in the response is
> extracted and mapped to its tool-result origin. The test suite fails the build if any number is
> unmapped. The API makes the guarantee *inspectable*, not merely promised.

### `POST /assistant/voice` — audio in (Bhashini ASR) → same pipeline → audio out (TTS)

## 10. Reference & System

| Endpoint | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `GET /reference/crops` | Full crop DB — cached, offline seed |
| `GET /reference/diseases` | Disease + treatment library — offline seed |
| `GET /reference/schemes` | All schemes — offline seed |
| `GET /reference/land-units?state=Haryana` | Conversion factors (FR-1.5) |
| `GET /reference/model` | On-device ONNX model + version manifest |
| `GET /health` | Liveness |
| `GET /health/deep` | DB, Redis, model-load status, hours since last ingest |
| `GET /metrics` | Prometheus |

### `GET /sync/bootstrap` — one call, everything the PWA needs to work offline
```json
{ "data": { "profile": {}, "farms": [], "plots": [],
            "latest_recommendation": {}, "cached_prices": [], "weather": {},
            "reference_versions": { "crops": "v12", "diseases": "v8", "schemes": "v5" } },
  "meta": { "generated_at": "…", "valid_for_days": 7 } }
```

## 11. Rate Limits

| Group | Limit |
|---|---|
| Auth OTP | 10/min/IP · 3/hour/phone |
| Read endpoints | 120/min/user |
| Recommendations | 20/min/user |
| Disease scan (server) | 10/min/user |
| Assistant | 30/min/user |

`429` includes `Retry-After` and `X-RateLimit-Reset`.

---

## 12. Endpoint Summary

| Method | Path | Req | Auth |
|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/auth/otp/request` · `/auth/otp/verify` · `/auth/refresh` · `/auth/logout` | FR-1.1 | — |
| GET/PATCH | `/me` | FR-1.2 | ✓ |
| POST/GET | `/farms` · `/farms/{id}/plots` | FR-1.3/1.4 | ✓ |
| POST | `/plots/{id}/soil-test` | FR-1.6 | ✓ |
| POST | `/recommendations/gap-crop` | FR-2 | ✓ |
